record_title: Sharp harmonic stability phase diagram for low-cost UBU integrators
provenance: Harmonic stability analysis of the LC-UBU, LCT-UBU, and LCP-UBU schemes introduced in arXiv:2609.20713, compared with established stochastic-Verlet linear analysis in Journal of Statistical Physics 193, 12 (2026).
limitations: The theorem is exact for quadratic potentials and Schur/finite-second-moment stability of the affine Gaussian chain. It is not a nonlinear stability theorem or a comparison of invariant-measure bias inside the stable region.
